authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W01-W04 + W02 policy/authority core; W04 acceptance before runtime release
defaults.mission: Deterministic execution boundary: ActionIntent -> current Policy/Authority -> target resolution -> execute -> readback -> Receipt/Evidence; idempotency, preconditions, quotas, uncertainty reconciliation, circuit breaker and kill switch.
sources: - Action Plan v0.4.1 W07 + Device/Edge amendment

tasks.title: W07-00 - Executor Plane Coordination & Boundary Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W01-W04/W02 accepted outputs and W07 prerequisites.
2. Freeze W07 ownership, package/service paths, shared-surface locks and internal DAG.
3. Freeze ActionIntent consumption and determine compatibility-safe evolution required for execution-target-neutral receipts/evidence.
4. Define W07 publication barriers for W08/W09/W14/W15 consumers.
5. Create initial risk register, premortem, load/failure plans and acceptance matrix.
tasks.ownership: W07 governance, executor-owned contracts/services and coordinator-controlled shared publication surfaces.
tasks.forbidden: Do not implement provider adapters, Android runtime, n8n workflow runtime or business-domain decisions.

tasks.title: W07-A - ExecutionTargetReference & Target Kinds
actions: 1. Define versioned ExecutionTargetReference supporting PROVIDER, DEVICE, WORKFLOW and LOCAL_SERVICE.
2. Define target identity/reference semantics without fake provider IDs.
3. Define target compatibility and minimum resolution metadata.
4. Evolve ActionIntent/Receipt/Evidence only where compatibility-safe and necessary; preserve W01 canonical contracts.
5. Add contract/schema/property/consumer tests.
tasks.ownership: Execution-target contracts/schemas allocated by W07 ownership freeze.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create DeviceId/DeviceRef (W14), provider adapter logic (W08), or device runtime (W15).

tasks.title: W07-B - Executor SDK & Current Policy/Authority Validation
actions: 1. Implement deterministic Executor SDK boundary consuming ActionIntent.
2. Require current policy and authority validation whenever operation semantics require it.
3. Fail closed for missing/stale/expired/revoked/wrong-tenant/wrong-subject/wrong-scope/constraint-invalid authority.
4. Enforce operational readiness as mandatory for side effects where required; do not copy TOCA's optional-off default.
5. Prove Fast Lane and ExecutionBudget cannot bypass or weaken validation.
tasks.forbidden: Do not mint PolicyToken/OwnerDecision, implement a second Policy Engine, or let precheck/confidence authorize execution.

tasks.title: W07-C - Idempotency, Preconditions, Quotas & Deadlines
actions: 1. Implement generic idempotency key/ledger integration using W03 primitives.
2. Implement explicit preconditions, quotas, deadline/expiry and bounded-attempt semantics.
3. Define duplicate command handling before any external call.
4. Ensure replay/reconnect cannot duplicate irreversible side effects.
5. Add deterministic concurrency and race tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not embed provider-specific rate-limit policy or domain budget decisions.

tasks.title: W07-D - ExecutionTargetResolver
actions: 1. Resolve capability/ActionIntent target references to an executable target binding.
2. Validate target availability/freshness/compatibility and required preconditions.
3. Keep resolver deterministic and target-neutral.
4. Return canonical non-execution outcome when binding is stale/unavailable/ambiguous.
5. Prove target resolution alone never grants authority.
tasks.forbidden: Do not execute provider/device/workflow/local side effects in the resolver.

tasks.title: W07-E - Receipt, Evidence & Readback Semantics
actions: 1. Implement generic execution Receipt/Evidence production.
2. Define provider/device/workflow/local readback interface and correlation propagation.
3. Capture requested action, actual observed result, timestamps, target reference and uncertainty status without secrets.
4. Ensure evidence can reconstruct execution without private chain-of-thought.
5. Add schema parity and readback mismatch tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create W17 production telemetry stack or store credentials/secrets in evidence.

tasks.title: W07-F - EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN & Reconcile-Before-Retry
actions: 1. Model EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN separately from ordinary failure.
2. Detect timeout/connection-loss cases where a side effect may have occurred.
3. Implement reconcile-before-retry and prohibit blind retry.
4. Define terminal/recoverable/reconcile-required outcomes and bounded retry behavior.
5. Fault-inject ambiguous external state and prove duplicate prevention.
tasks.forbidden: Do not hide uncertainty by translating it to FAILED or auto-retry.

tasks.title: W07-G - Circuit Breaker, Kill Switch & Failure Containment
actions: 1. Implement bounded failure-containment primitives.
2. Support circuit breaker, target/provider degradation state, kill switch and safe cancellation semantics.
3. Define behavior for dependency outage, repeated failures, overload and cascading retries.
4. Ensure kill switch cannot be overridden by model/router/agent output.
5. Add recovery and degraded-mode tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not implement W17 SLO platform or W19 final security hardening.

tasks.title: W07-H - Executor Integration, Fault Injection & Consumer Publication
actions: 1. Integrate A-G with W03 idempotency/event foundations and W04 capabilities.
2. Run consumer fixtures for W08, W09, W14 and planned W15 target contracts.
3. Run failure injection: duplicate, timeout, stale authority, stale target, readback mismatch, circuit open, kill switch.
4. Run four Risk Gates and exact-head Quality/Test Build/Security.
5. Publish accepted public surfaces and produce handoff for dependent waves.
